point.title: 名词所有格
point.summary: 表示“……的”:单数名词及不以 s 结尾的名词加 's(Tom's, children's);以 s 结尾的复数名词只加撇号 '(students', boys')。无生命的事物多用 of 结构(the door of the room)。两人共有一物,只在最后一个名词后加 's(Lucy and Lily's room);各有其物,则各自加 's(Tom's and Sam's bags)。
point.examples: This is Lily's bag. / These are the students' books. / the legs of the table

questions.stem: This is ____ bag. It's not mine.
questions.explanation: 单数名词表所属加 's。

questions.stem: ____ pencil is on the desk.
questions.explanation: 单数名词加 's。

questions.stem: I have only one sister. That is my ____ room.
questions.explanation: 只有一个姐姐,单数名词加 's。

questions.stem: There are many students in our class. These are the ____ books, not the teachers'.
questions.explanation: 许多学生,以 s 结尾的复数名词只加撇号。

questions.stem: The ____ toys are new.
questions.explanation: 不规则复数 children 加 's。

questions.stem: I have two brothers. These are my ____ bikes.
questions.explanation: 两个哥哥,复数名词只加撇号。

questions.stem: Our class has only one teacher. Where is the ____ office?
questions.explanation: 只有一位老师,单数名词加 's。

questions.stem: The ____ room is over there.
questions.explanation: 不规则复数 women 加 's。

questions.stem: Is this ____ ruler?
questions.explanation: 单数名词 Jack 加 's。

questions.stem: The door ____ the room is red.
questions.explanation: 无生命名词多用 of 结构表所属。

questions.stem: There are five boys in this room. These are the ____ desks.
questions.explanation: 五个男孩,复数名词只加撇号。

questions.stem: Do you like ____ new dress?
questions.explanation: 单数名词 Anna 加 's。

questions.stem: The colour ____ the car is black.
questions.explanation: 无生命名词用 of 结构。

questions.stem: The three girls are my friends. The ____ bags are on the floor.
questions.explanation: 三个女孩,复数名词只加撇号。

questions.stem: The legs ____ the table are short.
questions.explanation: 无生命名词 table 用 of 结构。

questions.stem: That is ____ office.
questions.explanation: 单数名词 Mr Green 加 's。

questions.stem: My two ____ books are on the desk.
questions.explanation: 复数名词 friends 只加撇号表所属。

questions.stem: Lucy and Lily are sisters. They share one bedroom. ____ bedroom is very big.
questions.explanation: 共有一间卧室,只在最后一个名词后加 's。

questions.stem: Tom and Sam each have a schoolbag. ____ schoolbags are both red.
questions.explanation: 各有其物,两个名词都加 's。

questions.stem: We have one teacher and many students. Is this ____ dictionary or ____?
questions.explanation: 一位老师(单数加 's)、许多学生(复数只加撇号)。
